renderer.prompt: Render a physically based macro photograph of one bounded handcrafted miniature engineering campus. Center a tall purple routing tower with 47 physical drawer marks. At left, show repository intake and a planning workshop. At right, show a lever-operated red policy and human-approval gate, a dark-green validation workshop with an evidence archive, and a governed project-workspace output bench. Connect the structures with raised black pathways and brass direction markers. Use tactile paper, painted card, wood, acrylic, metal, visible joins, consistent miniature scale, warm museum lighting, physical occlusion, cast shadows, and contact shadows. Integrate exactly six major architecture labels plus title, takeaway, source, signature, and date plaques. Do not add clouds, logos, dashboards, floating cards, invented metrics, extra identities, or deployment claims.

elements.label: Repository Intent
elements.caption: A repository request enters the governed workflow as current-project evidence.

elements.label: Clarify & Plan
elements.caption: Clarification resolves material choices before an executable workflow is planned.

elements.label: Route 47 Skills
elements.caption: The orchestrator routes each eligible step to one bounded owning skill.

elements.label: Policy + Human Approval
elements.caption: Policy and explicit human approval gate external, privileged, and mutating actions.

elements.label: Validate + Record
elements.caption: Schemas, security checks, tests, and verification produce repository evidence.

elements.label: Evidence Archive
elements.caption: Machine-readable reports preserve authoritative workflow and validation evidence.

elements.label: Governed Project Workspace
elements.caption: The installer and templates establish a verified governed workspace baseline.

elements.label: Governed Flow
elements.caption: Work moves from intent through planning, routing, controls, validation, and evidence.

elements.label: Human Judgment
elements.caption: People remain responsible for requests, approvals, review, and final decisions.
